notes.title: DEATHSPRINT 66 Update 4 – “Ashen”
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=pdQ0eli5WzI;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello Clone Jockeys,   

 
Thank you all for playing [i][b]DEATHSPRINT 66[/b][/i] and your continued support.   


Today we are releasing our fourth major update – “[i][b]Ashen[/b][/i]” – which brings plenty of exciting new content to the game, all for free!   


First up are three brand new maps set in a whole new biome: [i][b]Scorched[/b][/i], [i][b]Caldera[/b][/i], and [i][b]Meltdown[/b][/i]. These maps are burning hot – literally – and feature our new [i][b]Flamethrower[/b][/i] trap.   


To celebrate these new maps there will be an extended feature playlist event running from 6pm (GMT) today until 6pm (GMT) on Monday, 17th February.  

 
That’s not all, as we are also introducing a brand-new ability: The [i][b]Ad Spammer[/b][/i]. Disorient the other racers by subjecting them to the visual noise that is advertisements.   

 
Finally, we have the brand-new Response racing suit, several new banners, and an increase to the Awards level cap from 40 to 50, offering players plenty of new levels and rewards to earn.   

 
Make sure to read the full patch notes below, as there are plenty more fixes and tweaks to be found in this update.   


Update 4 will be going live at 2pm GMT, so there may be a brief interruption in play. You will need to restart Steam and download the update when it goes live.   


[h2][b]Patch Notes:   [/b][/h2]

  
[b]Abilities: [/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Added the Ad Spammer ability.[/b]
[/list]  
[b]Dev Comment:[/b] “The newest ability to join the line-up gives you the chance to impair other players’ vision. When used, all others on the track will be temporarily subject to a bombardment of onscreen adverts, pop ups, jingles, and more. This will limit their visibility on the race, but the most skilled jockeys should be able to carry on. Should.”  


[list]
[*] [b]Added new voice lines to provide more feedback on incoming abilities from other players.   

[*] Fixed an issue where the ability icon on the back of a player would display incorrectly.  

[*] Fixed an issue where a player may not be granted an ability when passing over a tribute while using the Mag Shield in the Shield for All event playlist.  
  
[*] Balance pass of the Enraged Charge ability.   [/b]
[/list]
[b]Dev Comment:[/b] “We’ve taken a long look at the Enraged Charge and made several adjustments to improve its behavior and make it a more reliable option. Now, when using the Enraged Charge, players will follow the track on a more fixed line. To facilitate this, we have strongly reduced player’s input while using the Enraged Charge and disabled the option to drift. Furthermore, we now check if there is a trap in front of you before ending Enraged Charge to ensure you don’t immediately wipe out. All together, we think this makes Enraged Charge a more reliable option to catch up to the front of the pack. As always, we welcome your feedback on these changes.”  
  

[b]Maps:  [/b]


[b][list]
[*] Added the maps [i]Scorched[/i], [i]Caldera[/i], and [i]Meltdown[/i] to the PvP map rotation.   
[/list][/b]
[b]Dev Comment:[/b] “With our newest maps we wanted to go the extra mile and deliver some of the most challenging tracks to date all with a completely new visual style. Set in a new biome, each map will test players’ skills as they try to find that ideal race line. All that fire isn’t just for show, as these maps feature our new Flamethrower trap that will make quick and spicy work of any clone foolish enough to play with fire. That’s not all, as lava has made its way onto parts of the track and will offer the same toasty fate. We couldn’t be more excited to put these maps into the hands of our players and we look forward to seeing your lap times.”  

 
[list]
[*] [b]Added the maps Scorched, Caldera, and Meltdown to the Rehearsal map list.  

[*] Fixed instances of incorrect AI behavior on several maps.    

[*] Fixed instances of incorrect kill volumes and collisions on several maps.   

[*] Fixed instance of missing collisions allowing players to skip sections of levels and checkpoints on several maps. [/b] [/list]


[b]Progression:  
[/b]
 
[list]
[*] [b]Increased the level cap for Death, Glory, and Style Awards from 40 to 50.   [/b]
[/list]
[b]Dev Comment: [/b]“We’re adding a total of 30 new Award progression levels for Clone Jockeys to climb through, of whom will be rewarded with the new Response racing suit. Sleek and aerodynamic, this sponsored design is based on the actual suits used by Bachman Response employees. It also comes in 15 eye-catching colours. Additionally, there are also new Banners to unlock as you race to the new level cap.”    


[b]UI: [/b]  

 
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed an issue where leaderboards would display incorrect or missing results. 
  
[*] Fixed instances of missing localisation for non-Latin-based languages.   

[*] Fixed instances of incorrect highlighting on the Rewards screen when unlocking a Prestige level.   

[*] Fixed an issue where “New Event” was not translated across all languages.   

[*] Updated event UI to improve readability.    

[*] Fixed an issue where Banners would not update correctly in the Clone Data screen after completing a race.   [/b]
[/list]


[b]Misc:   [/b]


[list]
[*] [b]Fixed an issue where the water droplet VFX would display incorrectly, causing a black vignette to fill the screen. [/b]
[/list]  

[list]
[*] [b]Miscellaneous adjustments and fixes.   [/b]
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1273560/DeathSprint_66/      


Once again, we thank you so much for your continued support and feedback. That’s all for now. See you on the track!

notes.title: Introducing Update 4 – “Ashen”
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=C89EO1NLP_I;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello Clone Jockeys,    


The Bachman Media Network is proud to announce the next major content update – Ashen – releasing on Wednesday 12th February. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937985/b8069967af6414684cfa3511ecc34dbb78e1af6c.png[/img]

Things are about to heat up with our three brand new tracks: Scorched, Caldera, and Meltdown. Unique to these maps is a brand-new Flamethrower trap, where one misstep will leave clones crying for mercy as they are set ablaze.  Hazardous lava also makes its debut. Even the merest of touches will seriously hurt! 


Our sponsors are getting heavily invested in this update – perhaps too much – with the new Ability: Ad Spammer. Temporarily impair your competitors’ vision with pop-ups from sponsors and give them a friendly nudge into the lava as you run past. 


And that’s not all: a brand-new suit with fifteen colour variations, ten new ranks for each of the three award tracks, plus plenty of bug fixes and tweaks will all feature in the Ashen update. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937985/7f0200077ea3a719ef86e299522f3cb35a0e8a07.png[/img]

notes.title: An Update on Update 4
notes.notes:
Hello Clone Jockeys,    


A few months ago, we released a roadmap of four updates for DEATHSPRINT 66. Three of these updates are now live, and the fourth was due to release this month. 

 
This update contains a new trap, ability, cosmetics, and three new maps. All of these (except the ability) are connected by the core theme of fire. 


Unfortunately, due to current events going on in the world, we feel that it would be insensitive to fully unveil and celebrate this update in the next week as originally planned. 


Therefore, we have taken the difficult decision to delay the fourth update until a more suitable time. We are not looking to edit or remove any content from Update 4 and will share an update on new timelines in due course. 


If you would like to show support for the victims of the Los Angeles wildfires, here are some resources where you can find out more information: 

https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/how-to-help-victims-los-angeles-wildfires-rcna187274  

https://www.calfund.org/funds/wildfire-recovery-fund/  


Thank you for your understanding. 


Secret Mode and Sumo Newcastle.

notes.title: DEATHSPRINT 66 Update 3
notes.notes:
Hello Clone Jockeys,  

 
Thank you all for playing [i]DEATHSPRINT 66[/i] and your continued support.  

 
Today we are releasing our third major update and are excited to roll out Events, which will bring special time-limited playlists to PvP. 


What better way to celebrate this update than to start with an AR map focused event featuring three brand new maps: [i]Sakura[/i], [i]Hard-Drive[/i], and [i]Virus[/i].


[previewyoutube=ye4wHn-htKY;full][/previewyoutube]


That’s not all, as there are plenty more fixes and tweaks in this update, so make sure to read the full patch notes below.  
 

Update 3 will be going live at 11AM GMT, so there may be a brief interruption in play. You will need to restart Steam and download the update when it goes live.  
  

[b]Patch Notes:  [/b]
 
[b]Events: [/b]

[b][list]
[*] Added an Events playlist to Online PvP.   
[/list][/b]
[b]Dev Comment:[/b] “Events offer new time limited playlists with featured maps and rules for players to enjoy, offering yet more ways to play.  
 
Now, when you select PvP from the main menu you will find two options. The left ‘Showtime – PvP’ is the current DEATHSPRINT 66 experience featuring all maps with standard rules. The right ‘Special Event’ option will be where you find the new time limited events.  
 
Events will typically run weekly from 6pm (GMT) on Friday until 6pm (GMT) on Monday, giving players plenty of time to enjoy that weekend’s event. While playing in the Event playlist, you will receive 2x Fame helping you climb the ranks faster! 
 
To celebrate this update, our first event ‘Holonet Connect’ – which is a featured playlist of all our AR maps - will be live for an extended period, running from when the update goes live until 6pm (GMT) on Monday, 16th December. 
 
We’ll have more specific details to share soon on what to expect from future events. Aside from curated playlists and 2x Fame, we plan on bringing some fun gameplay modifiers to mix things up even more!” 
 

[b]Offline Mode: [/b]

[b][list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Awards were displaying an incorrect level on the Clone Data screen while in Offline Mode. 
[/list][/b] 
 
[b]Maps: [/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Added the maps [i]Sakura[/i], [i]Hard-Drive[/i], and [i]Virus[/i] to the PvP map rotation, Rehearsal map list, and online leaderboards.

notes.title: DEATHSPRINT 66 Update 2
notes.notes:
Hello Clone Jockeys,   


Thank you all for playing [i]DEATHSPRINT 66[/i] and your continued support.   


Today we are publishing our second major update and are excited to release Prestige Mode, giving players the chance to earn special cosmetic rewards by climbing through five Prestige Ranks.   


What better way to show off your new rewards to other players than with three brand new maps: [i]Vertigo[/i], [i]Blackout[/i], and [i]Smog[/i]? 


[previewyoutube=5VFC_dzI7sI;full][/previewyoutube]


That’s not all, as there are plenty more fixes and tweaks in this update, so make sure to read the full patch notes below.   
  

Update 2 will be going live at 2PM GMT, so there may be a brief interruption in play. You will need to restart Steam and download the update when it goes live.

[b]Prestige Mode:[/b]

[*] Added the functionality for a player to Prestige once they reach Fame Rank 66.[/list][/b]

Once you reach Fame rating 66, select the new ‘Prestige’ button on the Clone Data screen and start your journey to legendary status. With each Prestige rank, your Fame rating will reset, but you’ll keep all of your unlocks and gain those aforementioned special cosmetics to show off with. Players who Prestige will also be granted the Bachman Media Network Verified Tick, awarded to only the most enduring of jockeys. All will know that you are part of an elite fellowship who have survived the carnage.”

notes.title: DEATHSPRINT 66 Update 1
notes.notes:
Hello Clone Jockeys,   

  
Thank you all for playing DEATHSPRINT 66 and your continued support.   


Today we are releasing our first major update and are excited to introduce one of the community’s most requested features into the game: Offline Mode.   


That’s not all though. We are also adding five of our AR-themed maps from the PvE Episodes to the PvP map rotation. There are plenty more fixes and tweaks in this patch, so make sure to read the full patch notes below.    


Update 1 will be going live at 2PM GMT, so there may be a brief interruption in play. You will need to restart Steam and download the update when it goes live.   
 

[b]Patch Notes:   [/b]

  
[b]Offline Mode:  [/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Added the functionality to play the PvE and Rehearsal modes while offline.  [/b]
[/list]
[b]Dev Comment:[/b] “We’ve heard your requests for an Offline Mode and today we are introducing just that. Once you have installed the update, you will be able to launch the game without an internet connection and enjoy both the PvE and Rehearsal game modes. For new players, there is no need to go online before using Offline Mode meaning once the game is downloaded, you can start playing regardless of your internet connection. While not required, we do still recommend going online every so often to ensure you have the latest version installed.”  


[b]Abilities: [/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Fixed an issue where using the Enraged Charge ability could cause the player to change direction incorrectly.   [/b]
[/list]
  

[b]Maps: [/b] 

[list]
[*] [b]Added the maps Holonet, Encryption, Firewall, Connection, and Upload to the PvP map list and Rehearsal map list, plus added PvP leaderboards for these maps.   [/b]
[/list]
[b]Dev Comment: [/b]“Another community request we heard was for the PvE maps to be added to the PvP map rotation. The five maps have been touched up to ensure they are race ready, and we look forward to seeing your leaderboard times.”   


[list]
[*] [b]Fixed instances of players not respawning correctly on several maps.   [/b]
[/list]


[b]UI:   

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where “Apply” on the Clone Data screen would become non-functional.   

[*] Fixed an issue where the player was required to select “Apply” twice to assign rewards.    

[*] Fixed an issue where multiple items would be highlighted on the pause menu.   

[*] Fixed an issue where the exclamation point would never clear from the Clone Data screen.   

[*] Fixed instances of UI elements not being correctly aligned on 16:10 aspect ratios.   

[*] Fixed an issue where PvP would always be highlighted when returning to the main menu.
[/list]  [/b] 

  
[b]Options:  [/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Fixed an issue where the Frame Rate Limiter (Background) option was not functioning correctly.   [/b]
[/list]


[b]Misc:   

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where ‘Death’ progression was being miscalculated.  

[*] Fixed an issue where the ‘Practice’ achievement would unlock incorrectly after completing the tutorial.    

[*] Fixed an issue where blood decals could sometimes disappear and reappear.   

[*] Miscellaneous adjustments and fixes.
[/list] [/b]
  

Once again, we thank you so much for your continued support and feedback. That’s all for now. See you on the track!

notes.title: DEATHSPRINT 66 Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello Clone Jockeys. 

 
Thank you all for playing DEATHSPRINT 66 and your continued support.   

 
While the team are hard at work on plenty of exciting things, today we are publishing our next patch which is focused on addressing several bugs and community feedback. This includes the much-requested change to the size of the Mine collision. 


The other headline changes are further balances to the abilities, along with improvements to several tracks to address instances of players getting stuck or caught in respawn loops. There are plenty more fixes and tweaks, so make sure to read the full patch notes below.   


Patch 1.1 will be going live at 2PM BST, so there may be a brief interruption in play. You will need to restart Steam and download the update when it goes live.   


[h3][b]Patch 1.1 Notes:   [/b][/h3]
   

[b]Abilities:  [/b]

[list][*] 
[b]Reduced the overall size of the Mine collision.   [/b]
[/list]
[b]Dev Comment:[/b] “We’ve heard your feedback on the size of the Mine collision and agree that it’s currently too big. With this change, we have reduced the overall size to ensure a better gameplay experience and allow for much closer calls while avoiding them.”   
[list]

[*] [b]Made balance adjustments to the percentage chance of which ability a player will be granted, along with how long the EMP affects a player.  [/b]
[/list]
[b]Dev Comment:[/b] “In [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1273560/view/4663003775401894752]Hotfix #1[/url], we made changes to how often the EMP would be granted to players. With this update, we have made further adjustments to how long the EMP will affect a player. 

Additionally, we have tweaked the percentage chances for which ability will be granted depending on a player's race position. We think this will allow for players at the back of the pack more opportunities to make a comeback, keeping races engaging and limiting frustration for those out front.”   
[list]

[*] [b]Fixed a crash that could occur when the player was granted the Mag Shield ability.   [/b]

[*] [b]Fixed an issue where a player could temporarily get stuck if they activated the Enraged Charge ability while airborne over a gap.  [/b]
[/list]
   
[b]Maps:[/b]  

[list]
[*] [b]Fixed instances across multiple maps where the player could get stuck or find themself caught in a respawn loop.[/b]
[/list]   
[b]Dev Comments:[/b] “We have done several passes of the tracks to address areas where players were finding themselves caught in respawn loops or just simply stuck, unable to continue a race. 

 
Additionally, we have fixed instances of kill volumes extending just a bit too far onto some of the tracks which were causing unintended player deaths. We hope these changes will improve the race experience for all players, and we will continue to make improvements to our tracks moving forward.”  
[list]

[*] [b]Adjusted the locations of checkpoints on the track Bayview to account for players jumping over gaps towards the start and end of the track.   [/b]
[/list]
[b]Dev Comment:[/b] “These shortcuts were not something we had intended to be present on this track. However, after seeing how much the community has come to love them, we decided the best thing to do was keep them. With that in mind, we have adjusted the locations of the checkpoints on this track to ensure players can still use these shortcuts without the risk that they can’t finish the race. Keep those new lap records coming!”  


[b]UI:[/b]   

[list]
[*] [b]Fixed the kill feed not showing the correct information in some circumstances.   

[*] Fixed an issue where other player’s Fame rank badges would appear than disappear in the pre-match lobby screen.   

[*] Fixed an issue where the player Fame and Awards screens would display incorrectly until the player reached Fame rank 2.   

[*] Fixed an issue where non-latinised text in usernames was not displaying on multiple screens.   

[*] Fixed an issue where ‘Contestant’ was not translated correctly in all languages.   

[*] Fixed issues on the Clone Data screen which prevented controls from working correctly. [/b][/list]

[b]Options:  [/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Fixed an issue where the colour blindness settings would reset when launching the game.   

[*] Fixed an issue where the controls would become unresponsive if the player died while the pause menu was opened.  

[*] Fixed an issue on the Options menu where changing the camera to inverted would have no effect.   

[*] Fixed an issue where DLSS was always set to ‘Quality’ in the Options menu when the game is launched.   

[*] Fixed an issue where the text ‘Off’ and ‘On’ in the Options menu was displaying in the wrong language. [/b][/list]
   
[b]Misc: [/b]  

[list]
[*] [b]Fixed issues around players leaving matches in certain circumstances that would cause knock-on effects to match flow and wait times.   [/b]
[/list]

Once again, we thank you so much for your continued support and feedback. That’s all for now. See you on the track!

notes.title: DEATHSPRINT 66 Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Clone Jockeys.[/b]

 

We’d like to thank you all for playing DEATHSPRINT 66 – we are listening to your feedback and are working hard on delivering the best experience possible.  


Today we’re releasing our first hotfix, based on the community feedback and reports we've received so far. Your feedback helps us make the game better, so please keep them coming. 

 
This hotfix will be going live at 2PM BST, so there may be a brief interruption in play. You will need to restart Steam and download the update when it goes live. 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937985/02208eb9dedf1ee5f0724a75071ae86d422a3f20.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]The time between EMP’s being in the ability pool after use has been doubled. [/b]
[/list]
[b]Dev Comment: [/b]"We heard your feedback on how often the EMP was being used during races, especially on certain maps. To help reduce any frustration we have now doubled the time between the EMP being in the ability pool, meaning you should encounter it just a bit less."

 

[list]
[*] [b]The Mag Shield has been tweaked to stop players from achieving infinite speeds, but still allow them to go very, very fast. [/b]
[/list]
